title: A graph with three card types and five vertex orbits
summary: We prove that the answer to part~(b) of Problem~20.71 of the Kourovka Notebook is yes: there is a connected graph on $63$ vertices with exactly three isomorphism types of vertex-deleted subgraphs whose automorphism group has five orbits on the vertices. The graph is a Cayley graph of a Suzuki $2$-group of order $64$ with one vertex removed.
